risks.title: Non-battery suspension repair example — one axle
risks.detail: A conventional damper/strut job is an illustrative owner-paid repair after cover or for excluded damage. This is not a comprehensive electronics/accident budget and does not assert a failure pattern.
risks.priceBasis: ESTIMATE: 7X-specific quote unavailable; based on Australian conventional damper-pair A$650–1,300 guidance, with a larger allowance for heavy vehicle/OEM parts, mounts, alignment and local availability. Assumes parts, labour and GST. Air-suspension repairs on other trims can cost more.
risks.warranty: 5-year private-use vehicle term; insurance treatment depends on the event and chosen policy.

energyEstimate.basis: ESTIMATE, battery-side kWh/100km: 20 midpoint, range 17–23. Manufacturer nominal pack / target WLTP range is 75/480≈15.6 and 100/615≈16.3; apply roughly 25% real-driving/headroom margin at the midpoint for load, climate and nominal/usable uncertainty. It is a family proxy, not a road-test or homologated consumption figure. Add charging losses once.
